description.value: Cilantro UWS is a casual Mexican restaurant at 485 Columbus Ave on the Upper West Side. OpenTable describes authentic Mexican and Southwestern American cuisine in a casual, upbeat atmosphere, with a full bar of specialty cocktails and many varieties of tequila. The menu runs from guacamole and nachos to fajitas, tacos, burritos and enchiladas, with vegetarian and gluten-sensitive options. Brunch is served Friday through Sunday from 11am to 4pm, and OpenTable diners rate Cilantro UWS 4.1 from 23 reviews.
